reviews.title: Service
reviews.text:
I took my Kia to Firestone on Sept 29 for A/C issues. The staff member was very rude and acted like I invaded his home. He didn’t want to answer questions and I felt hurried out the door. 
After three days of no contact, I called them and was informed of the issues but it had to be taken to a Kia dealership. I wondered how long they were going to take before they called me. Also, when I arrived, I saw that my hood was left open. The only good thing about this business was the KIND young lady who took of me to pay for the diagnostic test. She was wonderful. I will never do business there again as half of what they said was wrong was actually fine. I do not trust them and do not recommend.
